description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git status behavior with symbolic links. It sets up test environments, performs operations involving symlinks and directories, and checks the output of 'git status'.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specified name and commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after the test.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
